pymatgen.zh: 分析这个 CIF 晶体结构的空间群、晶格参数和配位环境，并检查结构是否合理。
pymatgen.en: Analyze this CIF crystal structure for its space group, lattice parameters, and coordination environments, and check whether the structure is reasonable.

pymatgen.zh: 根据这组形成能数据构建相图，找出稳定相及其能量凸包距离。
pymatgen.en: Build a phase diagram from these formation energies and identify the stable phases and their energy above hull.

pymoo.zh: 以强度最大、成本最低为双目标，设计一个带工艺约束的 NSGA-II 优化方案。
pymoo.en: Design an NSGA-II optimization with maximum strength and minimum cost as objectives, subject to process constraints.

pymoo.zh: 分析这组候选配方的 Pareto 前沿，并推荐三个具有代表性的折中方案。
pymoo.en: Analyze the Pareto front for these candidate formulations and recommend three representative trade-off solutions.

uncertainty-and-units.zh: 计算该复合材料的比强度，统一输入单位，并传播密度和强度的测量不确定度。
uncertainty-and-units.en: Calculate the specific strength of this composite, normalize the input units, and propagate the measurement uncertainties in density and strength.

uncertainty-and-units.zh: 检查这份热导率计算是否存在量纲错误，并以合适的有效数字报告结果。
uncertainty-and-units.en: Check this thermal-conductivity calculation for dimensional errors and report the result with appropriate significant figures.

experimental-design.zh: 为温度、压力和保温时间三个因素设计一个复合材料成型的响应面实验。
experimental-design.en: Design a response-surface experiment for composite molding with temperature, pressure, and dwell time as factors.

experimental-design.zh: 为这项材料疲劳实验制定随机化、区组和重复测量方案，并说明样本编号规则。
experimental-design.en: Create a randomization, blocking, and repeated-measures plan for this materials fatigue experiment, including a sample-ID scheme.

exploratory-data-analysis.zh: 对这个材料性能 CSV 做探索性分析，检查缺失值、异常值、分布和潜在数据泄漏。
exploratory-data-analysis.en: Perform exploratory analysis on this materials-property CSV, checking missing values, outliers, distributions, and potential data leakage.

exploratory-data-analysis.zh: 比较不同批次拉伸数据的分布，并指出需要进一步核查的样品。
exploratory-data-analysis.en: Compare the tensile-data distributions across batches and flag samples that need further investigation.

statistical-analysis.zh: 比较三种热处理工艺的屈服强度，选择合适的统计检验并报告效应量和置信区间。
statistical-analysis.en: Compare the yield strength of three heat-treatment processes, choose an appropriate statistical test, and report effect sizes and confidence intervals.

statistical-analysis.zh: 分析纤维含量与冲击强度的关系，检查模型假设并解释结果的实际意义。
statistical-analysis.en: Analyze the relationship between fiber content and impact strength, check model assumptions, and explain the practical meaning of the results.

statistical-power.zh: 估算检测两种材料平均强度相差 8% 所需的样本量，功效设为 0.8。
statistical-power.en: Estimate the sample size needed to detect an 8% difference in mean strength between two materials with 0.8 power.

statistical-power.zh: 为包含批次效应的三因素实验做模拟功效分析，并给出样本量建议。
statistical-power.en: Run a simulation-based power analysis for a three-factor experiment with batch effects and recommend a sample size.

scikit-learn.zh: 用这份材料成分和工艺数据预测拉伸强度，建立包含预处理和交叉验证的基线模型。
scikit-learn.en: Predict tensile strength from this composition and process dataset using a baseline pipeline with preprocessing and cross-validation.

scikit-learn.zh: 比较随机森林和梯度提升模型，避免数据泄漏，并输出可复现的评估报告。
scikit-learn.en: Compare random-forest and gradient-boosting models, prevent data leakage, and produce a reproducible evaluation report.

statsmodels.zh: 用混合效应模型分析不同实验批次下温度对材料强度的影响。
statsmodels.en: Use a mixed-effects model to analyze how temperature affects material strength across experimental batches.

statsmodels.zh: 建立孔隙率与疲劳寿命的回归模型，给出残差诊断和置信区间。
statsmodels.en: Fit a regression model for porosity versus fatigue life and provide residual diagnostics and confidence intervals.

matplotlib.zh: 把这组应力—应变曲线绘制成适合论文的图，包含误差带、清晰图例和矢量导出。
matplotlib.en: Plot these stress-strain curves as a publication-ready figure with error bands, a clear legend, and vector export.

matplotlib.zh: 生成一个 2×2 多面板图，统一坐标轴、字体和颜色，并导出 PDF。
matplotlib.en: Create a 2×2 multi-panel figure with consistent axes, typography, and colors, and export it as a PDF.

seaborn.zh: 可视化不同配方组的强度分布，并叠加原始数据点和置信区间。
seaborn.en: Visualize strength distributions across formulation groups, including raw data points and confidence intervals.

seaborn.zh: 绘制材料特征的相关性热图，并突出与热导率关系最强的变量。
seaborn.en: Plot a correlation heatmap of material features and highlight the variables most strongly associated with thermal conductivity.

scientific-visualization.zh: 把这些实验结果整理成期刊风格的三面板图，统一配色、标注和统计符号。
scientific-visualization.en: Turn these results into a journal-style three-panel figure with consistent colors, annotations, and statistical symbols.

scientific-visualization.zh: 为材料工艺—结构—性能关系制作一张适合论文的综合可视化。
scientific-visualization.en: Create a publication-ready composite visualization of the process-structure-property relationships.

sympy.zh: 符号推导层合板等效模量公式，并验证各项的单位。
sympy.en: Symbolically derive the effective-modulus formula for a laminate and verify the units of each term.

sympy.zh: 求解这组耦合扩散方程的稳态解析解，并给出可代入参数的表达式。
sympy.en: Solve this coupled diffusion system for a steady-state analytical solution and provide a parameter-ready expression.

literature-review.zh: 系统检索近五年热塑性复合材料界面改性的研究，整理检索式、筛选标准和证据表。
literature-review.en: Systematically review the last five years of research on interface modification in thermoplastic composites, including search strings, screening criteria, and an evidence table.

literature-review.zh: 综述 PEEK 复合材料热压成型参数对孔隙率和力学性能的影响，并核验引用。
literature-review.en: Review how hot-pressing parameters affect porosity and mechanical properties in PEEK composites, with verified citations.

citation-management.zh: 核验这份参考文献列表的 DOI、作者和期刊信息，并生成规范的 BibTeX。
citation-management.en: Verify the DOIs, authors, and journal metadata in this reference list and generate clean BibTeX entries.

citation-management.zh: 查找这篇论文的准确引用信息，并检查是否存在撤稿或更正记录。
citation-management.en: Find the exact citation metadata for this paper and check for any retraction or correction records.

scientific-critical-thinking.zh: 评估这篇论文关于纳米填料提高韧性的因果结论，找出混杂因素和替代解释。
scientific-critical-thinking.en: Evaluate this paper's causal claim that nanofillers improve toughness, identifying confounders and alternative explanations.

scientific-critical-thinking.zh: 检查这组实验是否足以支持作者的机制解释，并列出还需要的关键证据。
scientific-critical-thinking.en: Assess whether these experiments support the proposed mechanism and list the critical evidence still needed.

scientific-writing.zh: 把这段材料实验结果改写成清晰、克制的论文 Results 段落，保留数值和不确定度。
scientific-writing.en: Rewrite these materials experiment results as a clear, restrained Results section while preserving values and uncertainties.

scientific-writing.zh: 根据这些要点起草论文的 Methods 部分，确保步骤可复现且不补造信息。
scientific-writing.en: Draft a reproducible Methods section from these notes without inventing missing information.

markitdown.zh: 将这份材料论文 PDF 转换成结构化 Markdown，保留标题层级、表格和图片引用。
markitdown.en: Convert this materials-science PDF into structured Markdown while preserving heading hierarchy, tables, and image references.

markitdown.zh: 把这组 Word 和 Excel 实验记录转换为便于检索的 Markdown 文件。
markitdown.en: Convert these Word and Excel experiment records into searchable Markdown files.

rdkit.zh: 计算这组聚合物单体的分子描述符和 Morgan 指纹，并进行相似性聚类。
rdkit.en: Calculate molecular descriptors and Morgan fingerprints for these polymer monomers and cluster them by similarity.

rdkit.zh: 在这个分子库中搜索包含指定官能团的候选物，并导出结构与匹配位置。
rdkit.en: Search this molecular library for candidates containing the specified functional group and export their structures and match locations.

molecular-dynamics.zh: 为聚合物—石墨烯界面建立分子动力学模拟方案，包括力场、平衡流程和质量检查。
molecular-dynamics.en: Design a molecular-dynamics workflow for a polymer-graphene interface, including force-field choice, equilibration, and quality checks.

molecular-dynamics.zh: 分析这组轨迹的均方位移、径向分布函数和温压稳定性。
molecular-dynamics.en: Analyze these trajectories for mean-square displacement, radial distribution functions, and temperature-pressure stability.

deepchem.zh: 用 DeepChem 建立分子溶解度预测基线，完成数据拆分、特征化和模型评估。
deepchem.en: Build a DeepChem baseline for molecular solubility prediction, including data splitting, featurization, and evaluation.

deepchem.zh: 比较图卷积模型与传统描述符模型在该材料数据集上的表现。
deepchem.en: Compare a graph-convolution model with a traditional descriptor model on this materials dataset.

molfeat.zh: 为这批聚合物单体生成 Morgan 指纹、理化描述符和预训练分子表示。
molfeat.en: Generate Morgan fingerprints, physicochemical descriptors, and pretrained molecular embeddings for these polymer monomers.

molfeat.zh: 比较几种分子特征在玻璃化转变温度预测任务中的效果和计算成本。
molfeat.en: Compare several molecular featurizers for glass-transition-temperature prediction in terms of accuracy and computational cost.

shap.zh: 用 SHAP 解释这个材料强度预测模型，展示全局重要性和三个样本的局部解释。
shap.en: Explain this material-strength model with SHAP, showing global importance and local explanations for three samples.

shap.zh: 检查 SHAP 结论在不同交叉验证折次中是否稳定，并指出相关特征带来的限制。
shap.en: Check whether the SHAP conclusions are stable across cross-validation folds and note limitations caused by correlated features.

torch-geometric.zh: 用 PyTorch Geometric 构建晶体图神经网络来预测形成能，并说明图的节点和边特征。
torch-geometric.en: Build a crystal graph neural network with PyTorch Geometric to predict formation energy, specifying node and edge features.

torch-geometric.zh: 为这组分子图实现训练、验证和批处理流程，并报告基线性能。
torch-geometric.en: Implement training, validation, and batching for these molecular graphs and report baseline performance.

pymc.zh: 建立一个分层贝叶斯模型，估计不同批次材料的真实强度及批次间差异。
pymc.en: Build a hierarchical Bayesian model to estimate true material strength across batches and quantify between-batch variation.

pymc.zh: 对这个疲劳寿命模型做后验预测检查，并诊断采样收敛情况。
pymc.en: Run posterior predictive checks for this fatigue-life model and diagnose sampling convergence.

networkx.zh: 把材料合成路线构建成有向网络，找出关键中间体和最短可行路径。
networkx.en: Represent these material synthesis routes as a directed network and identify critical intermediates and shortest feasible paths.

networkx.zh: 分析这个元素共现网络的中心性和社区结构，并生成可读的网络图。
networkx.en: Analyze centrality and community structure in this element co-occurrence network and create a readable network plot.

polars.zh: 用 Polars 清洗这批大型实验 CSV，统一类型和单位，并按配方汇总性能。
polars.en: Use Polars to clean these large experimental CSV files, normalize types and units, and aggregate properties by formulation.

polars.zh: 使用惰性查询连接样品、工艺和测试三张表，只输出通过质量检查的记录。
polars.en: Use lazy queries to join sample, process, and test tables and return only records that pass quality checks.

dask.zh: 用 Dask 分块处理这组超出内存的模拟结果，并计算每个工况的统计摘要。
dask.en: Use Dask to process these out-of-memory simulation results in partitions and compute summaries for each condition.

dask.zh: 把这个参数扫描任务改造成可并行执行的 Dask 工作流，并设置合理分区。
dask.en: Convert this parameter sweep into a parallel Dask workflow with an appropriate partitioning strategy.

scientific-schematics.zh: 绘制一张热压成型实验装置示意图，标注加热、压力、真空和测温位置。
scientific-schematics.en: Create a schematic of a hot-press molding setup, labeling heating, pressure, vacuum, and temperature-sensing locations.

scientific-schematics.zh: 制作一张纤维增强复合材料从工艺到微结构再到性能的机制图。
scientific-schematics.en: Create a mechanism diagram linking processing, microstructure, and properties in a fiber-reinforced composite.

peer-review.zh: 审阅这篇材料论文，重点检查实验设计、统计方法、机制证据和可复现性。
peer-review.en: Review this materials manuscript with emphasis on experimental design, statistics, mechanistic evidence, and reproducibility.

peer-review.zh: 把这些审稿笔记整理成主要问题、次要问题和给编辑的保密意见。
peer-review.en: Organize these review notes into major comments, minor comments, and confidential remarks to the editor.

pyzotero.zh: 从我的 Zotero 材料学集合中筛选含 PEEK 的文献，并按年份和主题整理。
pyzotero.en: Filter my Zotero materials collection for papers about PEEK and organize them by year and topic.

pyzotero.zh: 将这些 DOI 添加到指定 Zotero 集合，补全元数据并添加项目标签。
pyzotero.en: Add these DOIs to the specified Zotero collection, complete their metadata, and apply project tags.

get-available-resources.zh: 检查当前机器的 CPU、内存、磁盘和 GPU，判断能否运行这个分子动力学任务。
get-available-resources.en: Inspect the current CPU, memory, disk, and GPU resources and determine whether this molecular-dynamics job can run locally.

get-available-resources.zh: 根据当前可用资源，为这项参数扫描建议并发数、内存限制和存储预算。
get-available-resources.en: Recommend concurrency, memory limits, and a storage budget for this parameter sweep based on currently available resources.

materials-literature-rpsme-json.zh: 使用 @materials-literature-rpsme-json 提取 /绝对路径/paper.pdf 和 /绝对路径/SI.pdf，输出带证据的 RPSME JSON、中文摘要和校验报告。
materials-literature-rpsme-json.en: Use @materials-literature-rpsme-json to extract /absolute/path/paper.pdf and /absolute/path/SI.pdf into evidence-linked RPSME JSON, a Chinese summary, and a validation report.

materials-literature-rpsme-json.zh: 使用 @materials-literature-rpsme-json 处理这篇材料论文，完整核查配方、工艺、表征图像、性能和模拟复现信息；缺失项不要推断。
materials-literature-rpsme-json.en: Use @materials-literature-rpsme-json on this materials paper and audit its recipes, processing, characterization images, properties, and simulation reproducibility without inferring missing values.

materials-xyz-extraction.zh: 使用 @materials-xyz-extraction 从 /绝对路径/paper.pdf 提取工艺 X、微结构 Y 和力学性能 Z，生成 Ontology 2.0 JSON 和校验报告。
materials-xyz-extraction.en: Use @materials-xyz-extraction to extract process X, microstructure Y, and mechanical properties Z from /absolute/path/paper.pdf into Ontology 2.0 JSON with a validation report.

materials-xyz-extraction.zh: 使用 @materials-xyz-extraction 整理这篇热塑性复合材料论文，保留全部工艺组、15 类字段的缺项状态、证据页码和候选 X→Y→Z 关系。
materials-xyz-extraction.en: Use @materials-xyz-extraction on this thermoplastic-composite paper, preserving every process group, missingness across all 15 categories, evidence pages, and candidate X→Y→Z links.

analytical-method-validation.zh: 为合金中痕量元素的 ICP-MS 测定制定方法验证方案，列出线性、检出限和精密度检查。
analytical-method-validation.en: Plan validation of ICP-MS trace-element measurement in an alloy, including linearity, detection limits, and precision.

aeon.zh: 用热压设备的温度和压力曲线预测成型缺陷，并按生产批次做交叉验证。
aeon.en: Predict molding defects from hot-press temperature and pressure traces using batch-wise cross-validation.

cirq.zh: 用 Cirq 构造一个两量子比特自旋模型的电路，比较理想与含噪模拟结果。
cirq.en: Build a two-qubit spin-model circuit in Cirq and compare ideal and noisy simulation results.

database-lookup.zh: 查询公开材料数据库中的 LiFePO4 条目，保存请求条件、记录标识和访问日期。
database-lookup.en: Query public materials-database records for LiFePO4 and record filters, identifiers, and access date.

datalad.zh: 为显微图像和拉伸测试 CSV 建立可复现的数据版本，并记录每次分析命令。
datalad.en: Version microscopy images and tensile-test CSV files reproducibly and record each analysis command.

datamol.zh: 标准化候选环氧单体的 SMILES，去重并计算基础分子描述符。
datamol.en: Standardize candidate epoxy-monomer SMILES, deduplicate them, and calculate basic descriptors.

diffdock.zh: 评估一种生物基聚合物降解酶与候选小分子的对接姿态，并列出复核步骤。
diffdock.en: Evaluate docking poses for a biopolymer-degrading enzyme and candidate ligands, with validation steps.

fluidsim.zh: 建立树脂混合流场的二维模拟方案，检查网格、边界条件和收敛性。
fluidsim.en: Plan a two-dimensional resin-mixing flow simulation and inspect mesh, boundaries, and convergence.

hypogenic.zh: 根据复合材料疲劳寿命数据提出候选机制，并用留出集检查是否存在过拟合。
hypogenic.en: Propose mechanisms from composite fatigue-life data and test for overfitting on a held-out set.

hypothesis-generation.zh: 针对热压温度提高后孔隙率下降，提出三个竞争性机制和可区分它们的实验。
hypothesis-generation.en: For a drop in porosity after increasing hot-press temperature, propose three rival mechanisms and discriminating experiments.

iso-standards-readiness.zh: 梳理材料检测实验室的 ISO 17025 文件缺口，形成待补证据清单。
iso-standards-readiness.en: Review an ISO 17025 materials-testing laboratory for documentation gaps and produce an evidence checklist.

lab-hardware-cad.zh: 设计可调厚度的热压试样定位夹具，给出参数、STEP 文件和尺寸检查项。
lab-hardware-cad.en: Design an adjustable hot-press specimen fixture with parameters, STEP output, and dimensional checks.

liteparse.zh: 从一篇材料论文的 PDF 中定位拉伸强度表格及其页码和坐标。
liteparse.en: Locate a tensile-strength table in a materials PDF with its page number and coordinates.

markdown-mermaid-writing.zh: 把复合材料制备、表征和性能测试流程画成 Mermaid 图并附方法说明。
markdown-mermaid-writing.en: Diagram composite fabrication, characterization, and property testing in Mermaid with method notes.

matchms.zh: 比较两种聚合物热解产物的 MS/MS 谱图，报告相似度和可能的匹配物。
matchms.en: Compare MS/MS spectra from two polymer pyrolysis products and report similarity and candidate matches.

matlab.zh: 用 MATLAB 或 Octave 拟合 DSC 升温曲线，估计玻璃化转变区间并绘图。
matlab.en: Fit a DSC heating curve in MATLAB or Octave, estimate the glass-transition interval, and plot it.

medchem.zh: 为药物缓释涂层的候选活性分子检查结构警示和基础理化性质。
medchem.en: Check structural alerts and basic physicochemical properties for candidate drug-eluting coating molecules.

ontology-term-resolution.zh: 把实验记录中的化学物质名称映射到标准术语 ID，列出无法唯一匹配的名称。
ontology-term-resolution.en: Map chemical names in lab records to standard term IDs and list ambiguous matches.

open-notebook.zh: 为固态电解质项目建立文献笔记结构，记录证据摘录和待验证问题。
open-notebook.en: Create a literature-notebook structure for a solid-electrolyte project with evidence excerpts and open questions.

openpiv.zh: 分析树脂流动实验的两帧 PIV 图像，绘制速度场并标记异常矢量。
openpiv.en: Analyze two PIV frames from a resin-flow experiment, plot the velocity field, and flag outlier vectors.

optimize-for-gpu.zh: 评估邻居列表计算迁移到 GPU 后的数值一致性、显存占用和实际加速比。
optimize-for-gpu.en: Evaluate numerical agreement, memory use, and actual speedup after moving neighbor-list computation to a GPU.

paper-lookup.zh: 检索近五年 PEEK/碳纤维界面改性论文，去重并记录 DOI 和全文可得性。
paper-lookup.en: Find recent PEEK/carbon-fiber interface papers, deduplicate them, and record DOI and full-text availability.

pennylane.zh: 用 PennyLane 演示小分子能量的变分量子电路，并检查经典基线。
pennylane.en: Demonstrate a variational quantum circuit for small-molecule energy and compare a classical baseline.

pi-agent.zh: 检查 MaterialsX 的 Pi Skill 加载路径，并设计一个只读材料数据库工具。
pi-agent.en: Inspect MaterialsX Pi Skill loading paths and design a read-only materials-database tool.

pptx-posters.zh: 制作一页复合材料力学性能会议海报，包含方法、结果图和参考文献。
pptx-posters.en: Create a one-page conference poster on composite mechanical properties with methods, results, and references.

pytorch-lightning.zh: 为材料带隙预测建立 Lightning 训练框架，包含验证集、检查点和随机种子。
pytorch-lightning.en: Build a Lightning training workflow for band-gap prediction with validation, checkpoints, and fixed seeds.

qiskit.zh: 用 Qiskit 构建简化的自旋哈密顿量演示，说明测量误差和模拟器设置。
qiskit.en: Build a simplified spin-Hamiltonian demonstration in Qiskit and explain measurement error and simulator settings.

qutip.zh: 模拟半导体激子双能级系统的耗散动力学，绘制态占据随时间变化。
qutip.en: Simulate dissipative dynamics of a semiconductor-exciton two-level system and plot populations over time.

research-grants.zh: 为热塑性复合材料回收项目起草研究目标、工作包和三年里程碑。
research-grants.en: Draft aims, work packages, and three-year milestones for a thermoplastic-composite recycling proposal.

research-lookup.zh: 梳理固态电解质界面阻抗的近期证据，并区分实验结果与推测。
research-lookup.en: Review recent evidence on solid-electrolyte interfacial resistance and separate measurements from hypotheses.

scholar-evaluation.zh: 评议一篇材料机器学习预印本的数据泄漏风险、基线设置和可复现性。
scholar-evaluation.en: Review a materials-ML preprint for data leakage, baselines, and reproducibility.

scientific-brainstorming.zh: 围绕复合材料散热设计提出五个可实验验证的思路及主要反例。
scientific-brainstorming.en: Generate five experimentally testable ideas for composite thermal management with key counterexamples.

scientific-slides.zh: 把电池正极材料研究整理成十页组会报告，突出方法、结果和局限。
scientific-slides.en: Turn a cathode-materials study into a ten-slide group talk emphasizing methods, results, and limits.

simpy.zh: 模拟复合材料试样制备流水线，估算热压设备利用率和排队时间。
simpy.en: Simulate a composite-specimen production line and estimate hot-press utilization and queue time.

timesfm-forecasting.zh: 预测炉温传感器的短期趋势，与季节性基线比较误差。
timesfm-forecasting.en: Forecast short-term furnace-temperature readings and compare error against a seasonal baseline.

transformers.zh: 用材料论文摘要微调一个分类器，区分电池、催化和复合材料主题。
transformers.en: Fine-tune a classifier on materials-paper abstracts to distinguish battery, catalysis, and composite topics.

umap-learn.zh: 把材料配方描述符降到二维，标记高强度样本并检验随机种子敏感性。
umap-learn.en: Embed formulation descriptors in two dimensions, label high-strength samples, and test seed sensitivity.

vaex.zh: 扫描千万行材料传感器数据，统计异常温度区间而不一次载入全部数据。
vaex.en: Scan ten million materials-sensor rows for abnormal temperature intervals without loading all rows into memory.

venue-templates.zh: 将一篇材料论文改为目标期刊的章节、图表和参考文献格式。
venue-templates.en: Adapt a materials manuscript to a target journal's sections, figures, and reference style.

zarr-python.zh: 把三维 CT 孔隙图像分块保存为 Zarr，并验证切片读取与元数据。
zarr-python.en: Store a 3D CT porosity volume in Zarr chunks and verify slice reads and metadata.

geopandas.zh: 绘制材料实验场地的采样点与污染扩散边界，并统一坐标参考系。
geopandas.en: Map sampling sites and contamination boundaries for a materials test site in one coordinate reference system.

geomaster.zh: 结合遥感和地质图层筛选矿物原料采样区域，并报告空间不确定性。
geomaster.en: Combine remote sensing and geology layers to screen mineral-feedstock sampling areas and report spatial uncertainty.

stable-baselines3.zh: 在热处理温控仿真环境中比较 PPO 与规则控制基线，不连接真实设备。
stable-baselines3.en: Compare PPO with a rule-based controller in a simulated heat-treatment environment without connecting hardware.

torchdrug.zh: 用 TorchDrug 对聚合物添加剂分子建立图表示并预测一个已标注的性质。
torchdrug.en: Build graph representations of polymer-additive molecules in TorchDrug and predict a labeled property.

pytdc.zh: 选择适合生物医用涂层活性分子的公开性质数据集，并说明划分与许可。
pytdc.en: Choose a public property dataset for bioactive coating molecules and document its split and license.

protocolsio-integration.zh: 汇总公开的复合材料表面处理步骤，生成带来源的实验前检查清单。
protocolsio-integration.en: Summarize public composite-surface-treatment steps into a source-linked pre-experiment checklist.

labarchive-integration.zh: 从授权的实验记录中整理热压批次、试样编号和测量文件对应关系。
labarchive-integration.en: Organize hot-press batches, specimen IDs, and measurement files from authorized lab records.

lamindb.zh: 为配方数据、显微图像和性能预测模型建立可追溯的数据谱系。
lamindb.en: Create lineage linking formulations, microscopy images, and property-prediction models.

pufferlib.zh: 在模拟材料工艺环境中并行训练控制策略，记录随机种子和基线表现。
pufferlib.en: Train a controller in parallel simulated processing environments and record seeds and baseline performance.

polars-bio.zh: 为生物材料细胞相容性研究整理表达差异区间并记录数据来源。
polars-bio.en: Organize differential genomic intervals for a biomaterial cytocompatibility study with source provenance.
